groundTruth.author: LucieFaire
groundTruth.summary: Asked why the host config is suddenly required (answered: Fastify defaults to localhost, unlike Express).

findings.finding: APPLICATION_HOST is read in configuration.ts but the reviewed state adds no .env.sample.json entry.

ruleGapCandidates.observation: Test configuration copies the production env read verbatim (process.env.APPLICATION_HOST || '0.0.0.0') instead of a stable literal/faker value, silently coupling test config to the developer's shell; no rule distinguishes genuine connection-target fallbacks (POSTGRES_TEST_HOST) from values tests do not need from the environment.
